# Anivora 0.1.28 — Websites independent of Render

- Support now opens the independent Cloudflare site at https://anivora-f5a.pages.dev/ instead of the suspended Render website.
- The app homepage, full privacy policy and terms are available on Cloudflare. The personal developer portfolio remains separate at https://brandon300.is-a.dev/ with its updated links.
- Shared messages keep the original Render title link and add an independent Cloudflare alternative in the form `/details?id=…` (with `&type=manga` for manga). Android supports the new host while retaining the previous Render links and the existing Anivora custom scheme.
- Password-reset landing pages hand links to the installed app without sending reset fragments in HTTP requests. Actual password resets, sign-in, library sync and comments still require the API backend to be available. New email links use Cloudflare after the updated backend is deployed.
- Existing reader settings, chapter navigation, offline downloads, cached comments, server-status notices and expanded avatars remain available.

Payments are still disabled while the approved checkout is being prepared. This update does not restore the Render API or change email credentials. APK updates continue through the public Anivora-Releases feed and GitHub Releases assets only.

Android version code: **30**. Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer, using the existing signing certificate so it installs over the previous app. Do not uninstall before updating.

Validation includes TypeScript, lint, Expo compatibility checks, app and backend regression tests, website tests and mobile/desktop browser checks. The release pipeline additionally verifies Android tests, APK signature, package/version, ARM64 architecture and compiled-source identity before publication. Physical installation on an Infinix Hot 50i still requires a device check.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/05a23e0685ac693e0aa71debe68d12bb74a64ca4
